title: Compile element data
action: Gather first ionization potentials (IP, eV), electron affinities (EA, eV), and superconducting critical temperatures (Tc, K) for all elements listed in Table 1 of the source from the CRC Handbook and the Hotop & Lineberger compilation. Assemble the data into a structured file.
description: Intermediate dataset containing element parameters. Columns: element, IP (eV), EA (eV), Tc (K).
output_schema: Columns: element (str), IP (float, eV), EA (float, eV), Tc (float, K; leave empty for non-superconducting).

title: Compile alloy list and Tc
action: Collect the list of 51 binary alloys and their superconducting critical temperatures (Tc, K) from the CRC Handbook. Store the alloy name, constituent elements, and Tc.
description: Intermediate list of binary alloys with their Tc values. Columns: alloy, element_A, element_B, Tc (K).
output_schema: Columns: alloy (str), element_A (str), element_B (str), Tc (float, K).

title: Compute Mulliken electronegativity for elements
action: For each element in the compiled dataset, calculate Mulliken electronegativity χ = 0.5*(IP + EA). Output the computed χ along with the source IP, EA, and Tc.
description: Mulliken electronegativity values for all elements in the study. Columns: element, Tc (K), IP (eV), EA (eV), chi (eV).
output_schema: Columns: element (str), Tc (float, K; blank if none), IP (float, eV), EA (float, eV), chi (float, eV).

title: Compute equilibrium electronegativity for binary alloys
action: For each alloy, look up IP and EA of the constituent elements. Compute the low-temperature equilibrium electronegativity χ_eq_low = 0.5*(min(IP_A,IP_B) + max(EA_A,EA_B)) and the general formula χ_eq_general = (η_B * χ_A + η_A * χ_B) / (η_A + η_B) where χ = (IP+EA)/2 and η = IP - EA. Output both values.
description: Equilibrium electronegativities for binary alloys. Columns: alloy (str), Tc (K), chi_eq_low (eV), chi_eq_general (eV).
output_schema: Columns: alloy (str), Tc (float, K), chi_eq_low (float, eV), chi_eq_general (float, eV).

title: Compute Tc-weighted average electronegativities
action: From the element electronegativity data, compute the Tc-weighted average for superconducting metals (those with valid Tc): Σ(Tc_i * χ_i) / ΣTc_i. From the alloy equilibrium data, compute the Tc-weighted average for alloys using both the low-temperature and the general formula. Output the three averages.
description: JSON object containing the three Tc-weighted average electronegativities.
output_schema: Keys: metals_weighted_avg (float, eV), alloys_weighted_avg_low (float, eV), alloys_weighted_avg_general (float, eV).
